summary: Page 1 and Page 2 whole-peso comb amounts and Page 2 Last Name ('SANTOS') fit cleanly, but Page 2 Header TIN prints all 14 digits ('00012345300000') as plain text over the 9-digit TIN comb ticks beside the preprinted '00000' branch code, the official Page 2 bottom Tax Rate Tables (Table 1 and Table 2, referenced by Item 46) are omitted, Page 1 Item 10 Registered Address and Item 14 Foreign Tax Number print as plain text over comb ticks (shared), and long Page 2 Item 43 specify text shrinks to ~4.5pt.

test_data.profile: Juana Santos long-name/long-address demo profile (TIN 000-123-453-00000, RDO 008)
test_data.notes: Two-pass payload (pass 1: 19/19 applied; pass 2: 31/34 applied, 3 refused). Part II Spouse section stayed collapsed because the joint-filing toggle was not enabled, so Column B printed 0; 1701Q has no growable schedule row tables.

defects.description: Page 2 Header TIN prints the full 14-digit TIN ('00012345300000') as plain text across the 9-digit TIN comb ticks to the left of the preprinted '0 0 0 0 0' branch code, duplicating the branch code and colliding with comb ticks.

Official Page 2 bottom Tax Rate Tables (TABLE 1: 2018–2022 and TABLE 2: 2023 onwards, referenced by Item 46 'based on Tax Table below') are completely omitted, leaving the bottom ~15% of Page 2 blank.
Page 1 Item 10 Registered Address (both lines) and Item 14 Foreign Tax Number ('FTN-2025-8899001122') print as plain text over comb ticks.
Page 2 Schedule I Item 43 Non-Operating Income specify text shrinks to ~4.5–5pt for a 57-character description.
